name: Fragment Dissonant
description: Manifestation d'une réalité parallèle, Fragment Dissonant éclate en shards dissonants, maîtrise la Faille Dimensionnelle, arme une lame instable. Son existence même crée des distorsions spatio-temporelles, rendant les attaques ennemies imprévisibles et disjointes.

subject.archetype: Chaos-Touched Berserker - Fragment Dissonant entity merging human fury with extra-dimensional corruption, warped by reality-breaking forces

loadout.armor_outfit: Ruptured military armor fused with living shadow matter, plates bent by gravitational anomalies, floating debris embedded in skin, limbs twisted at impossible angles, surrounded by physically-detaching shadow tendrils, clothes reduced to floating tatters defying gravity
loadout.arsenal: Obsidian-violet energy blade dislocating into floating geometric fragments, surrounded by lévitating debris and distorting space, crackling magenta-black psychic aura warping nearby objects

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist in final desperate assault, body being captured but reaching backward in defiance, channeling catastrophic dark energy curse into captor position, completely committed to annihilating attack, arms outstretched as reality shatters around them
attitude.emotion: Transcendent rage mixed with cosmic horror - face frozen in scream of agony and ecstasy as reality fractures around the being, eyes rolled back showing only whites, blood streaming from self-inflicted wounds

palette_names.name: Abyssal Black
palette_names.role: dominant shadows and void areas creating oppressive darkness

palette_names.name: Deep Violet
palette_names.role: primary energy manifestations and glitch effects

palette_names.name: Sickly Flesh Pale
palette_names.role: cultist skin tones and exposed tissue

palette_names.name: Magenta Neon
palette_names.role: energy accents and reality distortion highlights

scenography.setting: Reality collapse zone - city district fragmenting into multiple overlapping parallel dimensions simultaneously, buildings existing as both intact and destroyed states layered over each other like corrupt Photoshop files, ground cracked open revealing parallel battlefields stacked vertically beneath, sky torn between conflicting celestial bodies (blazing sun contradicting frozen moon contradicting impossible void stars)
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: gravity malfunction creating debris falling in opposing directions simultaneously, air itself fracturing into visible glass-like cracks, chromatic aberration intensifying at dimensional boundaries, purple-black psychic energy vortex consuming the scene, reality distortion waves rippling outward from combatant position, floating geometric anomalies defying physics, shadows detaching physically from surfaces and becoming semi-autonomous
